items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: you was having to explain it to old Bert the other day what 'bring down' means

ctx.x: A lot of people can't remember the 'bring down.' You know, like you know you was having to explain it to old Bert the other day what 'bring down' means. Instead of a drag, you used to say 'bring down'.
Yes, I know that. That was current in '37 when I came.
